whyItMatters: deserialize deserializes julia objects from bytes, so hostile input can trigger gadget execution during decoding.
actions: Replace deserialize with a typed data format for any bytes that cross a trust boundary.
If object graphs must persist, authenticate the bytes (MAC/signature) and verify before decoding.
Re-run the scan and confirm no deserialize call remains reachable from untrusted bytes.
verification: Rescan shows no deserialize reachable from untrusted bytes, and hostile payloads decode to inert data or fail closed.
